regulation: 49 CFR 395.3, property-carrying drivers; the carrier operates every day (70 h / 8 days)

rules.text: may not drive without first taking 10 consecutive hours off duty
may not drive after a period of 14 consecutive hours after coming on-duty
may drive a total of 11 hours during the period
more than 8 hours of driving time have passed without at least a consecutive 30-minute interruption
satisfied either by off-duty, sleeper berth or on-duty not driving time
on duty 70 hours in any period of 8 consecutive days
on duty 70 hours in any period of 8 consecutive days
off-duty period of 34 or more consecutive hours
